# fee_module — EVM Fee Estimator

> EIP-1559 fee suggestion for EVM chains: slow/normal/fast tiers derived from eth_feeHistory, with custom overrides.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `suggest_fees` | `suggest_fees(chain_id: int) -> tstr` | Slow/normal/fast suggestions for a chain, derived from `eth_feeHistory`. |
| `estimate` | `estimate(chain_id: int, request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Resolve a concrete fee for ONE call, honouring any override. |
| `estimate_bundle` | `estimate_bundle(chain_id: int, request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Price a bundle of calls that will leave in order, from one account. |
